1. PREMISES. The Landlord leases to the Tenant the premises known as Suite [●], 400 Harbor Street, [City, State, ZIP] (the “Premises”).

2. RENT. The Tenant shall pay to Landlord a monthly base rent of $[●], payable in advance on the first day of each calendar month during the Term. The Parties will finalize the amount upon mutual agreement.

4. ASSIGNMENT. The Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet the Premises or any part thereof without the prior written consent of the Landlord, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed.
5. NOTICES. All notices must be sent to the parties at their respective addresses set forth in this Lease, or such other addresses as either Party may later designate in writing.
